title.orig: An Act Declaring Every 21st Day of June as a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Cabarroguis, Province of Quirino, to Be Known as "Araw Ng Cabarroguis"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7255_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: June 21st of every year is hereby declared as a special nonworking holiday in the Municipality of Cabarroguis, Province of Quirino, to be known as "Araw ng Cabarroguis."
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
